相纸反转: 相机内直接曝光相纸。试拍采用预洗、避光干燥的 Crystal Archive；约 5400 K 晴天，85B + 50Y + 40M，测试 EI 5 已计入这组滤镜。黑白首显、再曝光、RA-4 彩显及漂定。曲线为反射正像示意，±2 EV 为试拍预警，实际宽容度须按纸批、滤镜和工艺验证。
Paper reversal: Expose the paper in camera. In one trial, rinsed Crystal Archive paper dried in darkness gave EI 5 in 5400 K sunlight with 85B + 50Y + 40M filtration already included. The sequence uses a B&W first developer, re-exposure, RA-4 color development and bleach-fix. The reflection-density curve and ±2 EV warnings are illustrative. Bracket-test the paper batch, filtration and process.

相纸反转: Kodak AS-2652 的原材为 0.10 mm ESTAR 航空彩负。此处采用 Elevanfilm D2460 专用镜前滤镜和 E-6 正冲。约 5500 K 时滤镜方建议独立测光 EI 64–80，本预设从 EI 64 起试，已计入滤镜；透镜测光参考 EI 100。曲线为透射正像示意，±2 EV 预警须用本批胶片包围曝光验证。
Paper reversal: Kodak AS-2652 describes an aerial color negative on a 0.10 mm ESTAR base. This reversal workflow uses an Elevanfilm D2460 filter and E-6 processing. At 5500 K, the filter maker suggests EI 64–80 with a separate meter or EI 100 through the lens. The preset starts at EI 64 with filtration included. The transmission-density curve and ±2 EV warnings are illustrative. Bracket-test your own batch.
